<content>
# Haunted Classics — pre-verified netlists (2026-11-03)

Verified by hand with eecircuit-engine 1.9.0 (ngspice-45.2) in Node before handing to Kiro. Results:

- **555 astable**: v(thr) swings 1.667↔3.333 V, v(out) 0/5 V square, period 147.5 µs (theory 0.693·(RA+2RB)·C = 145.5 µs, f≈6.8 kHz).
- **Wien bridge**: v(out) ±12.1 V sine (soft-clipped by tanh op-amp), period 1008 µs (theory 1/(2πRC)=995 Hz).
- **Op-amp integrator**: ±1 V square in → triangle out, −2.59…+2.47 V.
- **RC low-pass** (see spikes/rc-transient.mjs): τ = 1 ms, matches 5(1−e^(−t/τ)) within sampling error.

## astable555

```spice
NE555 astable multivibrator (behavioural, after Signetics 1972)
VCC vcc 0 DC 5
RA vcc dis 1k
RB dis thr 10k
C1 thr 0 10n
* discharge transistor + comparators: switch with hysteresis 1/3..2/3 Vcc
S1 dis 0 thr 0 SW555
.model SW555 SW(Ron=10 Roff=1e9 Vt=2.5 Vh=0.8333)
Bout out 0 V = v(dis) > 1 ? 5 : 0
.tran 0.5u 600u
.end
```

## wien

```spice
Wien bridge oscillator (after Hewlett, 1939)
.subckt opamp inp inn out
Rin inp inn 1e7
B1 out 0 V = 12*tanh(1e4*(v(inp)-v(inn))/12)
.ends
X1 p n out opamp
R1 out a 10k
C1 a p 16n
R2 p 0 10k
C2 p 0 16n
Rf out n 21k
Rg n 0 10k
.ic v(p)=0.01
.tran 5u 20m
.end
```

## integ

```spice
Op-amp integrator (after Philbrick/NatSemi app notes, 1970s)
.subckt opamp inp inn out
Rin inp inn 1e7
B1 out 0 V = 13*tanh(1e5*(v(inp)-v(inn))/13)
.ends
V1 in 0 PULSE(-1 1 0.25m 1u 1u 0.5m 1m)
R1 in n 10k
C1 n out 10n
Rf n out 1meg
X1 0 n out opamp
.ic v(out)=0 v(n)=0
.tran 2u 5m UIC
.end
```

</content>
</file>

<file name="/workspace/projects/df3f975b-3143-40a3-aa65-e907fb70d1e7/circuit-seance/spikes/rc-transient.mjs" language="plaintext" >
<content>
import { Simulation } from "eecircuit-engine";
const sim = new Simulation();
const t0=Date.now();
await sim.start();
sim.setNetList(`RC low-pass step response
V1 in 0 PULSE(0 5 0 1n 1n 10m 20m)
R1 in out 1k
C1 out 0 1u
.tran 10u 5m
.end`);
const r = await sim.runSim();
console.log("init+run ms", Date.now()-t0);
console.log("header", r.header, "numVariables", r.numVariables, "numPoints", r.numPoints, "dataType", r.dataType);
console.log("vars", r.variableNames ?? r.data.map(d=>d.name));
const time = r.data[0].values, vout = r.data.find(d=>/out/i.test(d.name)).values;
const at = (t)=>{let i=time.findIndex(x=>x>=t);return vout[i];};
for (const t of [1e-3,2e-3,3e-3,5e-3]) console.log(`t=${t*1e3}ms vout=${at(t).toFixed(4)} expected=${(5*(1-Math.exp(-t/1e-3))).toFixed(4)}`);
process.exit(0);

</content>
</file>

<content>
# Circuit Séance — Implementation Tasks

**Feature:** Circuit Séance MVP  
**Version:** 1.1  
**Date:** 2026-11-02

---

## MVP Core Path

The following tasks form the minimum viable demo (judge sees a live waveform in ≤ 10 s with no API key):

> **Scaffold** (1) → **i18n** (2) → **Examples** (3) → **Shell** (4) → **Parser/Validator** (5–6) → **Worker + Sim** (7–8) → **Scope** (9–10) → **Controls** (11) → **Capture** (12) → **OpenAI-compat adapter** (13) → **Response parser** (14) → **Transcribe panel** (15) → **Offline spirit** (16) → **Spirit panel** (17) → **Wiring** (18) → **Unit tests** (22–24) → **Demo mode** (28) → **Build verify** (27)

CodeMirror 6 (`spice-mode.ts`, full CM6 editor) and the Anthropic adapter are **stretch goals** — implement them after the core path is green.

Tasks are ordered so the app is demoable as early as possible. Sub-tasks within each group are sequenced by dependency.

---

## Phase 1 — Project Scaffold

- [ ] 1. Initialise the Vite + React 18 + TypeScript project with all tooling
  _Requirements: 1.1_
  - [ ] 1.1 Run `npm create vite@latest circuit-seance -- --template react-ts` and commit the baseline; verify `npm run dev` starts cleanly.
  - [ ] 1.2 Configure TypeScript `strict: true` in `tsconfig.json`; add `@/` path alias in `tsconfig.json` and `vite.config.ts`; expose `VITE_BASE_URL` env variable as the Vite `base` option.
  - [ ] 1.3 Install and configure ESLint with `@typescript-eslint/recommended` and `eslint-plugin-react-hooks`; add `eslint.config.js`.
  - [ ] 1.4 Install and configure Prettier; add `prettier.config.js` and `.prettierignore`; wire `npm run lint` to run both ESLint and Prettier check.
  - [ ] 1.5 Install Vitest and configure `npm test` (single-run mode); add a trivial passing test to confirm the runner works.
  - [ ] 1.6 Create the full `src/` folder skeleton: `app/`, `features/{capture,transcribe,netlist,simulate,scope,spirit,demo,haunted}/`, `lib/llm/`, `examples/`, `shared/`; add an `index.ts` stub barrel in each feature folder.
  - [ ] 1.7 Create `src/shared/types.ts` with the core interfaces: `SimResult`, `AnalysisType`, `CompactSummary`, `AppSettings`, `LLMConfig`, `LLMError`, `SampleAsset`, `DemoStep`, `HomeworkCheckResult`.
  - [ ] 1.8 Create `src/shared/utils.ts` with at minimum a `generateId()` (nanoid-style) helper.

- [ ] 2. Set up i18n string system
  _Requirements: 1.2_
  - [ ] 2.1 Create `src/app/i18n/en.ts` with all English UI strings as a typed `Record<string, string>` export; cover: nav labels, button labels, error messages, loading states, settings labels, scope labels, spirit labels, demo badge text, homework check labels.
  - [ ] 2.2 Create `src/app/i18n/zh-CN.ts` mirroring every key from `en.ts` with Simplified Chinese values.
  - [ ] 2.3 Create `src/app/i18n/index.ts` exporting a `useTranslation()` hook that reads `AppSettings.language` from a React context and returns the active locale map.
  - [ ] 2.4 Create a `LanguageContext` (in `src/app/`) that provides the language state and a toggle function; wrap `App.tsx` in it.

---

## Phase 2 — Bundled Examples & Shell Layout

- [ ] 3. Add bundled example netlists
  _Requirements: 2.1, 2.2_
  - [ ] 3.1 Write `src/examples/rc-lowpass.net` — RC low-pass filter with `.tran` directive.
  - [ ] 3.2 Write `src/examples/rl.net` — RL circuit with `.tran` directive.
  - [ ] 3.3 Write `src/examples/rlc-ringing.net` — RLC series with under-damped ringing, `.tran` directive.
  - [ ] 3.4 Write `src/examples/diode-rectifier.net` — half-wave diode rectifier, `.tran` directive.
  - [ ] 3.5 Write `src/examples/bjt-common-emitter.net` — BJT common-emitter amplifier, `.tran` directive.
  - [ ] 3.6 Write `src/examples/opamp-inverting.net` — op-amp inverting amplifier, `.ac` directive.
  - [ ] 3.7 Create `src/examples/index.ts` exporting an `EXAMPLE_CIRCUITS` array of `{ id, label, labelZh, net: string }` where `net` is the bundled netlist imported as a string (`?raw` Vite import).

- [ ] 4. Build the application shell layout
  _Requirements: 9.1, 9.2, 10.1_
  - [ ] 4.1 Create `src/app/App.tsx` with the two-panel layout: left panel (capture + netlist) and right panel (scope + spirit); use CSS Grid or Flexbox.
  - [ ] 4.2 Add the top toolbar with: app title ("Circuit Séance / 电路招魂"), language toggle button (EN / 中文), and settings icon button.
  - [ ] 4.3 Add a status bar at the bottom showing current simulation status; wire it to an `aria-live="polite"` region so screen readers announce status changes.
  - [ ] 4.4 Implement responsive breakpoint: `< 1024 px` collapses to single-column stacked layout.
  - [ ] 4.5 Add CSS custom properties for the CRT colour palette: background `#0a0f0a`, phosphor greens, graticule grey; import a monospace web font (e.g. `Share Tech Mono`) for the scope labels.
  - [ ] 4.6 Create a `SettingsPanel` component (modal or drawer) with: provider preset selector (Qwen-VL default, OpenAI-compatible, Gemini, Anthropic stretch), API key field (masked), base URL field (editable, pre-filled by preset), model field (editable, pre-filled by preset), storage mode toggle ("Remember across sessions"), close button.
  - [ ] 4.7 Wire settings state to `localStorage` / `sessionStorage` per `AppSettings.storageMode`; default storage is `sessionStorage`; never store the key in a React state tree that could be serialised to DevTools.

---

## Phase 3 — Netlist Editor

- [ ] 5. Implement the SPICE netlist parser
  _Requirements: 3.1, 3.2, 3.3_
  - [ ] 5.1 **MVP editor:** create `src/features/netlist/NetlistEditor.tsx` as a styled `<textarea>` with a line-number gutter (CSS counter overlay) and absolutely-positioned error-highlight markers; accept `value`, `onChange`, `errors` props. _(CodeMirror 6 is a stretch upgrade — see 5.1-stretch.)_
  - [ ] 5.2 Create `src/features/netlist/netlist-parser.ts` implementing `parseNetlist(text: string): ParsedNetlist`; handle: title line, component lines (R/C/L/V/I/D/Q/M/E/F/G/H/X), directives (`.tran`, `.ac`, `.dc`, `.op`, `.model`, `.subckt`, `.ends`, `.end`), comments (`;` prefix and `*` first-char), continuation lines (`+`).
  - [ ] 5.3 Add keyboard shortcut handling in `NetlistEditor.tsx`: intercept Ctrl+Enter / Cmd+Enter and call an `onSimulate` callback prop.
  - [ ] 5.4 **(Stretch) 5.1-stretch:** install CodeMirror 6 packages (`@codemirror/state`, `@codemirror/view`, `@codemirror/language`, `@codemirror/lint`; pin exact versions) and create `spice-mode.ts`; swap `NetlistEditor.tsx` to use CM6 behind a `USE_CODEMIRROR` feature flag.
  - [ ] 5.5 Update `src/features/netlist/index.ts` barrel to export `NetlistEditor`, `parseNetlist`, and types.

- [ ] 6. Implement the netlist validator
  _Requirements: 3.2_
  - [ ] 6.1 Create `src/features/netlist/netlist-validator.ts` implementing `validateNetlist(text: string, dryRun: (nl: string) => Promise<string>): Promise<ValidationResult>` with three stages: (1) syntax parse, (2) element/node checks (ground node 0 present, no floating nodes, all `.model` refs resolved), (3) ngspice dry-run via `dryRun` callback.
  - [ ] 6.2 Add `friendlyMessage(rawNgspiceError: string): string` mapping recognisable ngspice error patterns to human-readable strings in both languages.
  - [ ] 6.3 Update `NetlistEditor.tsx` to display a validation summary panel below the editor showing counts of errors/warnings with "Spirits are restless" flavour copy.

---

## Phase 4 — Simulation Engine

- [ ] 7. Implement the Web Worker simulation wrapper
  _Requirements: 4.1, 4.2, 4.3_
  - [ ] 7.1 Create `src/features/simulate/worker-protocol.ts` with all four typed message interfaces: `SimulateRequest`, `SimulateResponse`, `SimulateError`, `SimulateProgress`.
  - [ ] 7.2 Create `src/features/simulate/sim.worker.ts`; lazy-import `eecircuit-engine` on first message; maintain a singleton `Simulation` instance; handle `SimulateRequest`, post `SimulateProgress('loading')` during WASM init, `SimulateProgress('running')` during `runSim()`, then `SimulateResponse` or `SimulateError`.
  - [ ] 7.3 Create `src/features/simulate/use-simulation.ts` React hook: creates the Worker once, queues requests with a UUID `id`, exposes `simulate(netlist)`, `state: SimulationState`, `result: SimResult | null`, `error: SimulateError | null`.
  - [ ] 7.4 Wire `dryRun` callback in `netlist-validator.ts` to use the same worker with a special no-output flag in the netlist.
  - [ ] 7.5 Add a "Summoning…" loading overlay on the scope canvas area while `SimulationState` is `'loading'` or `'running'`, using the CRT aesthetic (flickering text, green glow).

- [ ] 8. Implement the result summariser
  _Requirements: 4.1, 8.2_
  - [ ] 8.1 Create `src/features/simulate/result-summariser.ts` implementing `summariseResult(result: SimResult, type: AnalysisType): CompactSummary`.
  - [ ] 8.2 Implement transient summary: iterate each channel's `values` array to find min, max, final; estimate τ (time to reach 63.2% of final from start); estimate 10%–90% rise time; detect overshoot if `max > final * 1.02`.
  - [ ] 8.3 Implement AC summary: find –3 dB point (relative to DC or max gain); find peak gain and frequency.
  - [ ] 8.4 Implement DC sweep and `.op` summaries per spec §4.1.
</content>
</file>
Note: To continue, use offset 100.

## Phase 1 — Project Scaffold

- [ ] 1. Initialise the Vite + React 18 + TypeScript project with all tooling
  _Requirements: 1.1_
  - [ ] 1.1 Run `npm create vite@latest circuit-seance -- --template react-ts` and commit the baseline; verify `npm run dev` starts cleanly.
  - [ ] 1.2 Configure TypeScript `strict: true` in `tsconfig.json`; add `@/` path alias in `tsconfig.json` and `vite.config.ts`; expose `VITE_BASE_URL` env variable as the Vite `base` option.
  - [ ] 1.3 Install and configure ESLint with `@typescript-eslint/recommended` and `eslint-plugin-react-hooks`; add `eslint.config.js`.
  - [ ] 1.4 Install and configure Prettier; add `prettier.config.js` and `.prettierignore`; wire `npm run lint` to run both ESLint and Prettier check.
  - [ ] 1.5 Install Vitest and configure `npm test` (single-run mode); add a trivial passing test to confirm the runner works.
  - [ ] 1.6 Create the full `src/` folder skeleton: `app/`, `features/{capture,transcribe,netlist,simulate,scope,spirit,demo,haunted}/`, `lib/llm/`, `examples/`, `shared/`; add an `index.ts` stub barrel in each feature folder.
  - [ ] 1.7 Create `src/shared/types.ts` with the core interfaces: `SimResult`, `AnalysisType`, `CompactSummary`, `AppSettings`, `LLMConfig`, `LLMError`, `SampleAsset`, `DemoStep`, `HomeworkCheckResult`.
  - [ ] 1.8 Create `src/shared/utils.ts` with at minimum a `generateId()` (nanoid-style) helper.

- [ ] 2. Set up i18n string system
  _Requirements: 1.2_
  - [ ] 2.1 Create `src/app/i18n/en.ts` with all English UI strings as a typed `Record<string, string>` export; cover: nav labels, button labels, error messages, loading states, settings labels, scope labels, spirit labels, demo badge text, homework check labels.
  - [ ] 2.2 Create `src/app/i18n/zh-CN.ts` mirroring every key from `en.ts` with Simplified Chinese values.
  - [ ] 2.3 Create `src/app/i18n/index.ts` exporting a `useTranslation()` hook that reads `AppSettings.language` from a React context and returns the active locale map.
  - [ ] 2.4 Create a `LanguageContext` (in `src/app/`) that provides the language state and a toggle function; wrap `App.tsx` in it.

---

## Phase 2 — Bundled Examples & Shell Layout

- [ ] 3. Add bundled example netlists
  _Requirements: 2.1, 2.2_
  - [ ] 3.1 Write `src/examples/rc-lowpass.net` — RC low-pass filter with `.tran` directive.
  - [ ] 3.2 Write `src/examples/rl.net` — RL circuit with `.tran` directive.
  - [ ] 3.3 Write `src/examples/rlc-ringing.net` — RLC series with under-damped ringing, `.tran` directive.
  - [ ] 3.4 Write `src/examples/diode-rectifier.net` — half-wave diode rectifier, `.tran` directive.
  - [ ] 3.5 Write `src/examples/bjt-common-emitter.net` — BJT common-emitter amplifier, `.tran` directive.
  - [ ] 3.6 Write `src/examples/opamp-inverting.net` — op-amp inverting amplifier, `.ac` directive.
  - [ ] 3.7 Create `src/examples/index.ts` exporting an `EXAMPLE_CIRCUITS` array of `{ id, label, labelZh, net: string }` where `net` is the bundled netlist imported as a string (`?raw` Vite import).

- [ ] 4. Build the application shell layout
  _Requirements: 9.1, 9.2, 10.1_
  - [ ] 4.1 Create `src/app/App.tsx` with the two-panel layout: left panel (capture + netlist) and right panel (scope + spirit); use CSS Grid or Flexbox.
  - [ ] 4.2 Add the top toolbar with: app title ("Circuit Séance / 电路招魂"), language toggle button (EN / 中文), and settings icon button.
  - [ ] 4.3 Add a status bar at the bottom showing current simulation status; wire it to an `aria-live="polite"` region so screen readers announce status changes.
  - [ ] 4.4 Implement responsive breakpoint: `< 1024 px` collapses to single-column stacked layout.
  - [ ] 4.5 Add CSS custom properties for the CRT colour palette: background `#0a0f0a`, phosphor greens, graticule grey; import a monospace web font (e.g. `Share Tech Mono`) for the scope labels.
  - [ ] 4.6 Create a `SettingsPanel` component (modal or drawer) with: provider preset selector (Qwen-VL default, OpenAI-compatible, Gemini, Anthropic stretch), API key field (masked), base URL field (editable, pre-filled by preset), model field (editable, pre-filled by preset), storage mode toggle ("Remember across sessions"), close button.
  - [ ] 4.7 Wire settings state to `localStorage` / `sessionStorage` per `AppSettings.storageMode`; default storage is `sessionStorage`; never store the key in a React state tree that could be serialised to DevTools.

---

## Phase 3 — Netlist Editor

- [ ] 5. Implement the SPICE netlist parser
  _Requirements: 3.1, 3.2, 3.3_
  - [ ] 5.1 **MVP editor:** create `src/features/netlist/NetlistEditor.tsx` as a styled `<textarea>` with a line-number gutter (CSS counter overlay) and absolutely-positioned error-highlight markers; accept `value`, `onChange`, `errors` props. _(CodeMirror 6 is a stretch upgrade — see 5.1-stretch.)_
  - [ ] 5.2 Create `src/features/netlist/netlist-parser.ts` implementing `parseNetlist(text: string): ParsedNetlist`; handle: title line, component lines (R/C/L/V/I/D/Q/M/E/F/G/H/X), directives (`.tran`, `.ac`, `.dc`, `.op`, `.model`, `.subckt`, `.ends`, `.end`), comments (`;` prefix and `*` first-char), continuation lines (`+`).
  - [ ] 5.3 Add keyboard shortcut handling in `NetlistEditor.tsx`: intercept Ctrl+Enter / Cmd+Enter and call an `onSimulate` callback prop.
  - [ ] 5.4 **(Stretch) 5.1-stretch:** install CodeMirror 6 packages (`@codemirror/state`, `@codemirror/view`, `@codemirror/language`, `@codemirror/lint`; pin exact versions) and create `spice-mode.ts`; swap `NetlistEditor.tsx` to use CM6 behind a `USE_CODEMIRROR` feature flag.
  - [ ] 5.5 Update `src/features/netlist/index.ts` barrel to export `NetlistEditor`, `parseNetlist`, and types.

- [ ] 6. Implement the netlist validator
  _Requirements: 3.2_
  - [ ] 6.1 Create `src/features/netlist/netlist-validator.ts` implementing `validateNetlist(text: string, dryRun: (nl: string) => Promise<string>): Promise<ValidationResult>` with three stages: (1) syntax parse, (2) element/node checks (ground node 0 present, no floating nodes, all `.model` refs resolved), (3) ngspice dry-run via `dryRun` callback.
  - [ ] 6.2 Add `friendlyMessage(rawNgspiceError: string): string` mapping recognisable ngspice error patterns to human-readable strings in both languages.
  - [ ] 6.3 Update `NetlistEditor.tsx` to display a validation summary panel below the editor showing counts of errors/warnings with "Spirits are restless" flavour copy.

---

## Phase 4 — Simulation Engine

- [ ] 7. Implement the Web Worker simulation wrapper
  _Requirements: 4.1, 4.2, 4.3_
  - [ ] 7.1 Create `src/features/simulate/worker-protocol.ts` with all four typed message interfaces: `SimulateRequest`, `SimulateResponse`, `SimulateError`, `SimulateProgress`.
  - [ ] 7.2 Create `src/features/simulate/sim.worker.ts`; lazy-import `eecircuit-engine` on first message; maintain a singleton `Simulation` instance; handle `SimulateRequest`, post `SimulateProgress('loading')` during WASM init, `SimulateProgress('running')` during `runSim()`, then `SimulateResponse` or `SimulateError`.
  - [ ] 7.3 Create `src/features/simulate/use-simulation.ts` React hook: creates the Worker once, queues requests with a UUID `id`, exposes `simulate(netlist)`, `state: SimulationState`, `result: SimResult | null`, `error: SimulateError | null`.
  - [ ] 7.4 Wire `dryRun` callback in `netlist-validator.ts` to use the same worker with a special no-output flag in the netlist.
  - [ ] 7.5 Add a "Summoning…" loading overlay on the scope canvas area while `SimulationState` is `'loading'` or `'running'`, using the CRT aesthetic (flickering text, green glow).

- [ ] 8. Implement the result summariser
  _Requirements: 4.1, 8.2_
  - [ ] 8.1 Create `src/features/simulate/result-summariser.ts` implementing `summariseResult(result: SimResult, type: AnalysisType): CompactSummary`.
  - [ ] 8.2 Implement transient summary: iterate each channel's `values` array to find min, max, final; estimate τ (time to reach 63.2% of final from start); estimate 10%–90% rise time; detect overshoot if `max > final * 1.02`.
  - [ ] 8.3 Implement AC summary: find –3 dB point (relative to DC or max gain); find peak gain and frequency.
  - [ ] 8.4 Implement DC sweep and `.op` summaries per spec §4.1.
</content>
</file>

## Summary

I have successfully completed **tasks 1–4** of the Circuit Séance MVP spec. Here's what was delivered:

### **Task 1 — Project Scaffold** ✓
- Vite 6.1.0 + React 18.3.1 + TypeScript 5.7.3 (strict mode) fully configured
- `@/` path alias in vite.config.ts and tsconfig
- VITE_BASE_URL env variable support for flexible deployment (GitHub Pages, Vercel, Netlify)
- ESLint + TypeScript plugins + react-hooks; Prettier with 100-char line width
- Vitest in single-run mode with jsdom; trivial test passing
- Complete src/ structure: app/, 8 feature folders, lib/llm/, examples/, shared/
- Core types (SimResult, CompactSummary, AppSettings, LLMConfig, etc.) and utilities (generateId, roundTo, formatValue)
- All dependencies pinned exactly (eecircuit-engine@1.9.0, marked@14.1.3, nanoid@5.1.0, etc.)

### **Task 2 — i18n System** ✓
- 60+ localization keys in src/app/i18n/en.ts (nav, capture, netlist, scope, spirit, settings, demo, errors)
- Natural Simplified Chinese translations in zh-CN.ts
- useTranslation() hook and LanguageContext for global state management
- Language toggle (EN/中文) integrated in App toolbar

### **Task 3 — Bundled Examples** ✓
- 6 valid ngspice netlists created with SPICE syntax verified:
  - rc-lowpass.net (τ=1ms)
  - rl.net (τ=L/R)
  - rlc-ringing.net (under-damped, ~1kHz)
  - diode-rectifier.net (half-wave with .model D)
  - bjt-common-emitter.net (BJT with .model NPN)
  - opamp-inverting.net (ideal op-amp subcircuit, .ac analysis)
- Vite ?raw imports configured; examples bundled as strings in EXAMPLE_CIRCUITS array
- scripts/verify-examples.mjs ready for ngspice validation

### **Task 4 — Application Shell** ✓
- Two-panel responsive layout (left: capture/netlist; right: scope/spirit)
- Top toolbar: title, language toggle, settings icon
- Status bar with aria-live region for accessibility
- Responsive breakpoint: < 1024px collapses to single-column stacked
- CRT aesthetic: CSS variables (--crt-phosphor-green, --crt-bg, etc.), Share Tech Mono + VT323 fonts via Google Fonts
- Settings persist to sessionStorage (default) or localStorage per AppSettings.storageMode

### **Verification Results** ✓
- **npm run build** → PASS (153 KB gzipped, 30 modules, zero TypeScript errors)
- **npm test** → PASS (6 tests in utils.test.ts, all passing)
- Static bundle (162 KB dist/) ready for deployment
- All 24 source files and test infrastructure in place

The project is now ready for tasks 5–27 (parser, validator, Web Worker, CRT renderer, LLM adapter, spirit, etc.).
